items.Sentence: The current wastewater disposal method on site is tank and haul, where wastewater is stored in septic tanks and are hauled away to a wastewater treatment plant.
The expansion to the OWTS will use a biofiltration system that uses earthworms and microbial processes to provide secondary treatment to the wastewater.
The treated wastewater will be conveyed to an adjacent evaporation pond.

Minor wastewater flows of 300 gpd to 500 gpd include membrane backwash from potable water treatment system consisting of a membrane filtration system, ultraviolet disinfection units and hypochlorite injection.
